scope: Membership access reconciliation, recovery job and refund lifecycle only; not complete subscription checkout/billing
verified_native_behaviors: concurrent access grant and recovery job
canonical native entitlement deduplication and read-back
partial refund preserves current right and stops renewal
full refund revokes and never reactivates on replay
limits: Membership registered only by CI hook; production integration belongs to Claude
No completed initial/recurring checkout, saved-method/consent flow, HTTP/admin/storefront contract
Separate module transactions use replay/reconciliation; no instant global revocation guarantee across outages or issued tokens
Operational audit writes are best effort; no live payment calls or deployment
